newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korean soldier defects to South Korea.
newsitem.headline: North Korean soldier defects to South Korea.

text.p: A North Korean soldier defected to South Korea on Monday by crossing the tense border separating the two rivals, a defence ministry spokesman said.
The soldier, only identified as a sergeant, sought asylum in the western sector of the frontier at 9:17 a.m. (0017 GMT), he said.
The North Korean sergeant, who was spotted by South Korean border guards, was being questioned by military investigators, the spokesman said.
A growing number of North Koreans have fled their homeland recently amid warnings by international aid agencies that the food crisis threatening the communist state could become critical this summer.
The spokesman did not give details on how the North Korean soldier slipped through the heavily-fortified demilitarised zone bisecting the Korean peninsula.
North and South Korea are technically at war since their 1950-53 conflict ended in a truce instead of a peace treaty.
